## Resolution contract (§17)

Import declarations in each T0 tree are resolved with `ts.resolveModuleName`
against the **nearest ancestor `tsconfig.json`**, falling back to the T0 root
config. Only resolutions landing on a path inside the T0 tree become edges;
external and unresolved modules yield none. Path aliases and project references
are honoured exactly insofar as `ts.resolveModuleName` with the nearest project
options resolves them. Barrel/index files are ordinary nodes and paths continue
through them. Package identity is the nearest ancestor `package.json`.

Directed edge: **importer → resolved local module**. For candidate test `t` the
search runs from `t` toward any source in `S(T)`, breadth-first, maximum depth
**4**, cycles visited once.

## Symbolic links

Symbolic links are skipped during B2 filesystem traversal and are never emitted
as graph nodes: a symlink is not a local module definition, and following one can
escape the T0 tree. This implementation correction was made **before** the
pre-outcome freeze and is recorded as deviation **D1** in `REPORT.md`.
